title: 2026’s Smart Escalation Tracking for CX Leaders in Insurance
summary: High repeat contacts and SLA breaches often stem from poor escalation tracking tool visibility across claims and servicing workflows. Find out why.
body_markdown:
## Conclusion


Escalation tracking is no longer about managing exceptions. It is about controlling the most important moments in the customer journey.


Strada enables insurance CX leaders to move from fragmented escalation processes to a unified system that connects voice agent escalation rate tracking, SLA tracking and incident escalation solutions, and real-time intervention.


The result is measurable: fewer escalations, faster resolutions, higher CSAT, and more predictable operations.


If escalation tracking is still a reporting function in your organization, it is time to upgrade it into a performance system. Strada can show you how to reduce escalation volume while improving every CX metric you are measured on.
